note_title: 证明函数项级数几乎处处绝对收敛

callouts.id: 证明函数项级数几乎处处绝对收敛#1
callouts.title: 问题0
callouts.body: 考虑两个实数列$a_n,r_n$满足$\sum_{n\geq 1}|a_n|<\infty$，证明级数$$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{a_n}{\sqrt{|x-r_n|}}$$对$x\in \mathbb{R}$是几乎处处绝对收敛的。

classification_result.id: 证明函数项级数几乎处处绝对收敛#1

if_problem.statement_en: Let $a_n,r_n$ be two real sequences satisfying $\sum_{n\geq 1}|a_n|<\infty$. Prove that the series $$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{a_n}{\sqrt{|x-r_n|}}$$ is absolutely convergent for almost every $x\in \mathbb{R}$.

callouts.id: 证明函数项级数几乎处处绝对收敛#2
callouts.title: 想法1
callouts.body: 如果可以证明一个加强命题：此函数是可积的。如果可以做到这一点，那么我们就能通过可积得到几乎处处有限的结论。而证明可积，我们可以从Fubini-Tonelli定理的角度出发，因为$f(x)$交换以后在实数上的积分是容易计算的，如果交换以后的结果是有限的，那么一定是可积的。（详细参考[[Fubini-Tonelli定理的例子与反例]]其中有关于Fubini-Tonelli定理的一个使用技巧）

classification_result.id: 证明函数项级数几乎处处绝对收敛#2

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Strengthen to integrability and apply Fubini-Tonelli
if_strategy_template.summary_en: Instead of proving almost everywhere absolute convergence directly, prove the stronger statement that the resulting function is integrable. Then conclude it is finite almost everywhere, and use Fubini-Tonelli by swapping summation and integration when the exchanged integral is easy to estimate.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Use this when a pointwise almost everywhere finiteness claim can be upgraded to an integrability statement, especially for nonnegative series or absolute values where Tonelli's theorem allows exchanging summation and integration.

callouts.id: 证明函数项级数几乎处处绝对收敛#3
callouts.title: 想法2：把命题减弱一点
callouts.body: 我们实际上只需要证明在实数的任意一个开区间上的积分是可积的，从而函数在该区间上几乎处处有限。而可数个零测度的集合的并依旧是零测度的，于是因为实数可以表示为可数个这样的开区间的并，因此函数在整个实数上几乎处处有限。

classification_result.id: 证明函数项级数几乎处处绝对收敛#3

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Localize to bounded intervals and patch by countable union
if_strategy_template.summary_en: It is enough to prove integrability, or almost everywhere finiteness, on each open interval separately. Since the real line is a countable union of such intervals and a countable union of null sets is still null, the global almost everywhere conclusion follows.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Use this when a global statement on $\mathbb{R}$ is hard to prove directly but can be established on every bounded or open interval, and the target property is stable under countable unions up to null sets.
